title: Unicon submission
description: submission.json at the root of a submission commit. A submit writes one commit to the contestant's submission repo, as the contestant: the files of every code, file and file[] input under files/<input id>/<file name>, and this file naming them. The harness resolves a plan's {"submission": ...} values through it: a code or file input gives its one file, a file[] input its list of files, a text, number or boolean input its value, and the field language the language chosen for a code input. Everything before the commit re-checks this against the task's contestant inputs, so the harness trusts its shape only after checking it here.

schema_version.description: The submission shape this file is written against.

inputs.description: One entry per contestant input the task declares, keyed by the input id.

files.description: A code, file or file[] input: its files in the commit, and for code the language chosen from the input's language list. code and file carry exactly one file; file[] one or more.
Paths from the root of the commit, files/<input id>/<file name>.

language.description: The language chosen for a code input.

value.description: A text, number or boolean input, as the contestant gave it.
